title: At Least 5 Shot in D.C.'s Logan Circle as Barricaded Gunman Triggers Active Shooter Response
snippet: At least five people were injured in an active shooter incident in Washington, D.C., near Logan Circle on Thursday morning. Tactical units have surrounded a building where the suspect is barricaded.
content:
WASHINGTON — At least five people were wounded Thursday morning during an active shooter situation in Washington, D.C.’s Logan Circle neighborhood, drawing a massive emergency response roughly a mile north of the White House, officials said.

The Metropolitan Police Department (MPD) issued a critical alert instructing the public to avoid the area near 15th and P Streets NW following initial reports of gunfire shortly after 8:00 a.m.

Tactical Units Surround Barricaded Suspect

D.C. Police spokesperson Nicole Deaner confirmed that the shooter had not been taken into custody and had barricaded themselves inside a building along the 1500 block of 15th Street NW. MPD's Emergency Response Team, alongside federal agents from the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF), established a heavy perimeter and cordoned off surrounding city blocks.

D.C. Councilmember Brooke Pinto shared on X that the gunfire occurred "at and outside Vida Fitness," urging residents to stay clear of the neighborhood while law enforcement handles the ongoing standoff.

Bystanders Take Cover as Shots Ring Out

Local residents described a chaotic morning in the usually bustling neighborhood. Ryan Dubicki said he was inside his apartment around 8:00 a.m. when he heard roughly five distant noises. "They were really spread out, so I thought it was construction," Dubicki said, adding that he soon looked outside to find emergency vehicles swarming the block before receiving a building notice about the shooter.

Another witness, Max Smith, said he heard gunshots around 8:30 a.m. and quickly sought shelter in a nearby bagel shop with about ten other people. "I'm very shaken up," Smith told reporters. "You know, you don't expect it."

Authorities have not yet released information regarding the condition of the victims or a potential motive. The incident remains active as law enforcement officers work to resolve the barricade situation.
